definition: Reproduce PYF baseline outcome metrics before evaluating variants
pass_condition: Must calculate successfully for all included positions
caveat: No variant may be interpreted if PYF baseline fails

definition: Spearman rank relationship between candidate signal/rank and outcome finish
pass_condition: Must report candidate and PYF side by side

definition: Precision among rows classified as startable under NWR review format
pass_condition: Must not materially worsen versus PYF without clear caveat

definition: Top-12 hit rate where relevant by position
caveat: May be sparse for some positions

definition: Top-24 hit rate where relevant by position
caveat: May be sparse for some positions

definition: Top-36 hit rate where relevant by position
Difference between candidate metric and PYF metric
pass_condition: Must be explicit whether positive negative or neutral
caveat: Delta alone does not create a winner

definition: Performance and miss deltas on sparse-history rows
pass_condition: Must not materially worsen sparse-history errors without clear caveat

definition: Performance and miss deltas on low-games rows
pass_condition: Must not materially worsen low-games errors without clear caveat

definition: Count and concentration of PYF false positives among prior-decline rows
pass_condition: Must report whether candidate explains or reduces false positives

definition: Change in PYF false positives under candidate interpretation
pass_condition: May be promising only if broad harm does not increase

definition: Change in PYF false negatives under candidate interpretation
pass_condition: May be promising only if breakouts are not suppressed

definition: Outcome and PYF miss behavior by age and lifecycle buckets
pass_condition: Must report older elite and young sparse-history harm risks
caveat: Age/lifecycle is context not direct input

definition: Outcome and PYF miss behavior by role archetype
pass_condition: Must report high-volume false positives and sparse/low-volume false negatives
caveat: Role archetype is context not direct input

definition: Outcome and PYF miss behavior by confidence/coverage status
Rows present missing values and blocked-field flags by feature family
pass_condition: Must be reported before result interpretation
caveat: Missing values must not be faked

definition: Confirm all candidate inputs are decision-date safe for historical evaluation
Document source/use-gate status for every input
pass_condition: Any ambiguous or blocked gate stops affected candidate
